profileTimelineHint: Records operations after tracking was enabled. The first edit preserves the previous profile. AI revisions proceed autonomously.
memoryTimelineHint: Uses the existing audit log, retained for {{days}} days. Older entries may contain only summaries, not full revisions.
profileSavedPending: Profile saved; memory sync is pending. Recovery will continue automatically. No need to resubmit.
profileSaveFailed: Could not save the profile. Your draft is preserved.
profileDraftStale: Another operation updated this profile. Your draft is preserved. Copy any needed text, cancel editing, and revise the latest profile.
title: Memory Management
cogneeStatusSubtitle: Knowledge graph projection and federated recall status
clearStmConfirm: Clear all temporary short-term memories? This cannot be undone. Pending tasks and analysis are retained.
clickToEdit: Click a file on the left to edit
deleteFileConfirm: Delete note "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

daily.newNoteHint: No note for this date — it will be created on save
daily.retentionHint: Daily notes older than {{days}} days are distilled into long-term memory and deleted (adjustable in Config)
daily.deleteConfirm: Delete the note for {{date}}? This cannot be undone.

indexSyncResult: Synced {{synced}} · Unchanged {{unchanged}} · Removed {{removed}} · Failed {{failed}} · Wrote {{chunks}} chunks

cogneeDescs.enabled: Enabled by default; waits for model configuration while native memory and search remain available
cogneeDescs.sync_enabled: Project memory creates, updates, and deletes to Cognee asynchronously
cogneeDescs.recall_enabled: Query Cognee in parallel and fuse results with native recall
cogneeDescs.dataset_prefix: Namespace prefix for memory and relation indexes; cannot change while bound to existing data
cogneeDescs.timeout_seconds: Maximum wait for one Cognee query, including waiting for writes. The overall AI recall budget may expire first. Configure model request timeouts under Extraction models.
cogneeDescs.sync_batch_size: Sync tasks claimed per batch; relation projection can produce more documents.
cogneeDescs.max_retries: Jobs enter the failed queue after this limit
cogneeDescs.native_weight: RRF weight for SQLite, FTS, and embedding results
cogneeDescs.cognee_weight: RRF weight for Cognee graph and vector results
cogneeDescs.pipeline_timeout_seconds: Maximum wait for one ingestion, graph-building or enhancement stage, including internal requests and retries. This is not the entire rebuild deadline and does not override model request timeouts.
cogneeDescs.improve_interval_seconds: Minimum interval between graph improves per dataset; <=0 disables auto improve
cogneeDescs.sync_interval_seconds: Poll interval of the sync worker when idle
cogneeDescs.rrf_k: Smoothing constant of Reciprocal Rank Fusion; larger values smooth rank gaps
cogneeDescs.recall_pool_multiplier: Candidate pool amplification per source in federated recall
cogneeDescs.compact_enabled: Prune expired versions between batches; merge fragments on schedule when sync is idle, retaining current data
cogneeDescs.compact_interval_seconds: Minimum interval for automatic fragment compaction, which waits for idle sync; manual compaction is unaffected
cogneeDescs.compact_cleanup_interval_seconds: Fallback interval, extended to 9 times cumulative maintenance duration when slow. Version or vector-store growth can trigger earlier cleanup, after a cooldown of at least 60 seconds and twice maintenance duration.
cogneeDescs.sync_max_documents_per_group: Group publications by added plus retired documents, excluding retained fragments. Each group is independently verified and committed. All fragments of one source remain atomic, even when that source alone exceeds the limit.
cogneeDescs.sync_max_characters_per_group: Group publications by characters in added or changed documents without truncating text. Both publication limits apply. A single oversized source remains intact in its own group.
cogneeDescs.compact_cleanup_version_threshold: Trigger early cleanup when version manifests in the committed index grow by this count since the last maintenance. 0 disables this trigger. Failed and unpublished candidates do not count.
cogneeDescs.compact_cleanup_growth_mb: Trigger early cleanup when committed LanceDB files grow by this logical size since the last maintenance. 0 disables this trigger. Normal new data can also trigger a check; Lance still decides eligible removals under the retention policy and keeps current data. Recovery snapshots are not counted again.
cogneeDescs.compact_max_versions_per_run: Version cleanup limit shared across all vector tables in one round, at least 1. Higher values increase round duration and disk I/O. Current and user-tagged versions are retained.
cogneeDescs.compact_cleanup_budget_seconds: Starts with the first round and includes validation and snapshots. Continue a backlog in separate committed rounds while budget remains, yielding between rounds. 0 runs one round only. A native cleanup already in progress is allowed to finish.
cogneeDescs.compact_retention_days: How many days of historical versions to keep; the latest version is always kept
cogneeDescs.write_breaker_enabled: Pause projection claiming and auto-compaction when the process's own disk write rate exceeds the threshold
cogneeDescs.write_breaker_threshold_mb: Write volume threshold within the sliding window that trips the breaker
cogneeDescs.write_breaker_window_seconds: Sliding window length for write-rate sampling
cogneeDescs.write_breaker_cooldown_seconds: Cooldown after the breaker trips; re-evaluated on expiry
cogneeDescs.project_memories_enabled: Project memory text into Cognee. Disabling skips these tasks; backfill after re-enabling. Full builds require this option.
cogneeDescs.project_graph_enabled: Project native entity relations into Cognee. Disabling skips these tasks; backfill after re-enabling. Full builds require this option.
cogneeDescs.native_watchdog_enabled: Recycle the worker if a native graph operation stalls; retry uncommitted work after recovery. Keeping this enabled is recommended.
cogneeDescs.native_watchdog_restart_seconds: Applies only while holding the native database gate, not to model generation. Minimum: 120 seconds.
cogneeDescs.search_types: Comma-separated search types. Default: CHUNKS. Complex tag filters use source-verifiable chunk retrieval.
cogneeDescs.deep_search_types: Comma-separated methods for explicit deep recall: CHUNKS, CHUNKS_LEXICAL, GRAPH_COMPLETION, GRAPH_COMPLETION_CONTEXT_EXTENSION, SUMMARIES. Generative search may make additional model calls.
cogneeDescs.data_root: Storage location is owned by unified data management. Read only here to avoid accidentally opening an empty directory.

selectGoalHint: Select a goal from the list to view details
recurringHint: When enabled, all steps auto-reset to pending when the goal is marked complete, and the goal becomes active again. The AI advances this goal continuously within its heartbeat cycle — no fixed time interval.

cognee.setupHint: Cognee is enabled by default. Configure a chat model and an embedding model in Model Management to connect automatically, or select models below.
cognee.usageHint: Once configured, memory sync calls the extraction and embedding models and consumes your provider quota. You can disable Cognee or async projection below.
cognee.statusSubtitle: Backend availability, model mapping and maintenance
cognee.backfillConfirm: Queue all active memories and relation nodes for the current Cognee index? Inactive records remain in native storage. This uses model quota.
cognee.freshRebuildConfirm: Create a new graph generation from source memories without reusing the current build progress. Use this after graph damage or to extract everything again. Source content, previous datasets and backups are retained. This uses model quota and extra disk space; old datasets can be retired separately after the new graph passes verification. Start again?
cognee.rebuildConfirm: Keep native content and previous Cognee datasets, and rebuild active memories and relations in new datasets. This uses model quota and extra disk space. Native recall remains available until verification succeeds. Back up the complete storage volume first. Start?
cognee.chatConfigSubtitle: The LLM used by Cognee for knowledge-graph extraction, independent of the main chat model
cognee.embeddingConfigSubtitle: The embedding model used by Cognee for text vectorization
cognee.sourceAutoDesc: Selects compatible models from Model Management and connects once initial setup is complete. Changing the embedding model for an existing index requires a rebuild.
cognee.sourceModelDesc: Pins a model from Model Management; switching the main chat model does not affect Cognee
cognee.sourceCustomDesc: Fully custom provider / endpoint / API key
cognee.embeddingLockToggleHint: Locked by default for each dialog. Turning this off discards unsaved embedding edits.
cognee.embeddingLockedHint: Current settings are locked. Changing Cognee activation above does not change the embedding model.
cognee.embeddingUnlockedHint: Temporarily unlocked. Changing the vector space requires rebuilding the index. Saving, resetting or closing the dialog locks it again.
cognee.embeddingUnlockConfirm:
Changing the model, endpoint or dimensions can invalidate existing vectors and requires a full rebuild and verification in a new data volume. The backend still rejects incompatible changes to the current volume.

Unlocking only permits editing in this dialog. It does not save settings, delete data or start a rebuild. Turning editing off discards unsaved embedding changes.
cognee.embeddingSaveNote: Save changes to this card together. Activation-only changes do not submit embedding settings. Existing-index compatibility checks still apply.
cognee.instructorModeHint: Uses native structured output by default. Selecting a mode enables Instructor; override only for endpoint compatibility.
cognee.maxCompletionTokensHint: Leave blank or enter 0 to use the default output limit. This does not limit output to zero tokens.
cognee.reasoningEffortHint: Uses the model's thinking contract. Auto inherits model settings; off requires model support. For switch-only models, every enabled level turns thinking on. The provider determines the actual budget.
cognee.datasetsSubtitle: Inspect content and storage by build generation and select an old generation to clean up. Expand its datasets to inspect details or maintain the current index.
cognee.catalogBusy: The index is busy. Showing the last confirmed datasets; this list updates after the batch commits.
cognee.catalogPending: Waiting for the first catalog observation. Dataset availability is not yet known.
cognee.generalSubtitle: Projection sync and federated recall parameters
cognee.hotApplyNote: Saved settings apply automatically after any active batch finishes. No restart required.
cognee.applyPending: Configuration saved; waiting for the active batch to finish or the new configuration to initialize. Active work keeps its original settings.
cognee.applyFailed: Configuration saved but not yet applied
cognee.saveFailed: Could not save configuration. Please retry.
cognee.reasoningModelHint: This model supports thinking. Choose a level below; thinking may increase extraction latency and usage. Keep enough output budget for structured content.
cognee.compactScheduled: Background maintenance requested. It will run at a safe batch boundary; you can close this window and follow its status on the page.
cognee.compactFailed: Maintenance request failed; check backend logs
cognee.probeSubtitle: Observability of async deep retrieval during replies (delta beyond base recall; empty injection is normal when the first round covered it)
cognee.probeNoActivity: No activity yet (planner triggers only when needed — try a relation question like "How are X and Y related?")
cognee.projectionHint: The new index is enabled only after item-level verification. Routine dependency and retrieval updates do not trigger rebuilds.
cognee.projectionInventory: Initial inventory: {{memories}} active memories, {{relations}} relation nodes; {{excluded}} inactive/planning records retained in native storage.
cognee.projectionLegacyPreserved: Preserved {{count}} complete legacy projection documents. The new index uses current authoritative memories; historical content remains available in the memory database.

projectionPhases.required: New index required; using native recall
projectionPhases.requested: Request saved; waiting for a safe execution window
projectionPhases.building: Extracting and indexing; native recall available
projectionPhases.failed: Verification failed; source retained. Fix the error and resume.

queue.title: Sync queue
queue.pendingHint: Waiting to be claimed; excludes processing
queue.failedHint: Retries exhausted or nonretryable; resolve and retry
queue.syncedHint: Source records with an index mapping
queue.countHint: Counts source records, not Cognee documents. Mapped records can also have updates in the queue.
queue.indexWithUpdates: Index available; changes still need syncing
queue.noProjection: Queue counts are independent of index build state

progress.stale: Status refresh failed. This is the last snapshot and does not confirm the worker is still running.
progress.overallHint: Counts commit after a whole batch succeeds; final verification is still required. New writes during the build can change the total.
progress.scanningHint: Scanning source pages while building projections. Pending grows as records are queued; it is not the total or duplicate memories.
progress.verifyingHint: Checking sources, fingerprints, tags and extraction status before enabling the index.
progress.stopped: The sync task is not running. The queue is preserved; retry sync and check Last error for the specific cause.
progress.retrying: {{count}} previously failed items remain in the automatic retry queue.
progress.retryAfter: Earliest eligible retry: {{time}} (processed in queue order)
progress.configPending: New model/settings saved; waiting for the current batch to finish. This batch may still use the previous model.
progress.batch: Current batch: {{count}} source records · highest attempt {{attempt}}
progress.deadline: Current stage: {{elapsed}} / deadline {{limit}}. Internal model calls may time out and retry earlier.
progress.pipelineHint: Includes skipped old documents and failed items. Resets per call and updates roughly every 5%; it does not mean re-extraction or a successful commit.
progress.waitingReport: Extraction is running; waiting for Cognee to report item counts.
progress.readError: Partial progress read failed; showing the last observation
progress.quietHint: No new batch completion marker observed for over 5 minutes. A document or model request may still be running; this is not a deadlock diagnosis.
progress.restartHint: A normal restart resumes the saved queue and cursors when sync is enabled. Source memories and old datasets are retained; interrupted batches may be extracted again. A saved pause survives restarts; no new full rebuild request is needed.
progress.pausePending: Pause requested: finish this batch, then stop without claiming another.
progress.syncPaused: Sync paused; the queue is preserved. Restarts keep it paused. Resume sync to continue.
progress.expectedKinds: {{memories}} memories + {{relations}} relationship nodes (inventory at build start)
progress.inventoryPending: Checking source records; the expected total appears after inventory. An unknown total does not mean zero.
progress.cleanupHint: Cleans superseded projections and uncommitted remnants. Shared entities remain protected by Cognee ownership checks. Cleanup completion still requires validation and a safe commit.
progress.cleanupAwaitingCommit: Cleanup complete; awaiting index validation and a safe commit.
progress.actualHint: Counts only new or changed documents in this batch; fragments are a subset. Extraction still requires validation and a safe commit. Unchanged old documents are excluded.
progress.awaitingCommit: Batch extraction complete; awaiting pipeline wrap-up, validation and a safe commit.
progress.waitingActual: Reading batch completion markers. Unknown is not zero; SDK traversal counts are not actual completions.
progress.awaitingVerification: Initial estimate reached; the queue must still drain and final validation must pass.

cognee.storageScope: Current and retained indexes, raw documents and metadata within the Cognee directory. Native memory and backups outside this directory are excluded.
cognee.storageMeasured: Measured: {{time}}. Refreshed in the background every 10 minutes and after cleanup.
cognee.storagePending: A complete measurement is not available yet. Background scanning is running; temporary zero values do not mean the disk is empty.

retirementStages.failed: Cleanup failed; inspect the error before retrying
retirementStages.interrupted: Cleanup interrupted; archives and backups retained

cognee.retirementHint: Pause sync first. After source scanning and backup, an unreferenced old generation can be removed before the current build finishes. Original text, tags and provenance are archived and backed up before deletion. Current progress and native memory are retained. Keep at least one old generation with content until acceptance. Once accepted with all changes synced, all old generations may be removed.
cognee.datasetBytesUnknown: No attributable index measurement yet. Shared documents and metadata are not divided among individual datasets.
cognee.retirementConfirm: Clean up “{{name}}”? Complete text, tags and provenance will be archived and the native database backed up before removing this old dataset and its indexes. Current indexes, native memory and backups are retained. Shared files and free database pages may not release disk space immediately.

publication.title: Index protection
publication.committing: Closing, reopening, verifying and committing snapshot
publication.policy: Native memories are retained. Failed candidate writes restore the last commit before retrying unfinished work. Old graphs and user backups are cleaned manually.
publication.sizeHint: Logical file sizes are shown. Filesystems supporting block sharing let snapshots reuse unchanged data, so this total is not exclusive disk usage.

cognee.generationHistoryUnknown: Historical acceptance status was not recorded; success or failure is unknown.
cognee.generationMeasurementHint: Document counts come from the committed index manifest. Extraction markers do not establish generation acceptance. Sizes are logical graph and vector file sizes, exclude shared source files, metadata and protection snapshots, and are not a prediction of reclaimed disk space.
cognee.retirementGenerationConfirm: Clean up generation “{{name}}”? It contains {{datasets}} datasets and {{documents}} confirmed documents, with {{size}} of logical dedicated indexes. Source ownership is checked and full text, tags and provenance are archived and backed up before all selected old indexes are deleted. Current build progress and native memory are retained. This old generation will no longer be available for direct index rollback. Check available disk space after completion for actual savings.

cleanupBlockers.unavailable: The index catalog is busy or unconfirmed; cleanup is unavailable.
cleanupBlockers.running: A cleanup operation is already running.
cleanupBlockers.pause: Pause sync and wait for the current batch before cleanup.
cleanupBlockers.scan: Complete source scanning and backup, and wait for pending build requests.
cleanupBlockers.pending: The accepted index has unsynced changes; finish syncing before cleanup.
cleanupBlockers.retain: Keep at least one old generation with content until the current build is accepted. After acceptance, all old generations may be removed.

cognee.storageLogical: Logical directory size includes shared blocks; it is not exclusive disk usage.

coverageRepair.hint: Compare native memory with this generation and requeue only missing or stale content. Keep completed indexes and previous generations, then repeat full validation.
coverageRepair.busy: Wait for the current batch, maintenance or configuration update to finish.
coverageRepair.paused: Sync remains paused. Click Resume sync to process them.
coverageRepair.running: Sync will continue automatically. The new graph stays unavailable until validation passes.

cognee.requestTimeoutHint: Maximum wait for each Cognee model request. Leave blank to inherit the selected model; custom sources use the framework default. Try 300 seconds for slow models. Build-stage and recall budgets still apply.
cognee.requestTimeoutInvalid: Enter a finite number greater than 0, or leave blank to inherit.

settings.modelsHint: Choose extraction and embedding models, then set the model request timeout. These settings do not change the main chat model. Changing embedding models remains subject to existing-index compatibility checks.
settings.recallHint: Control how Cognee participates in AI retrieval. Query and model request timeouts are separate; the overall AI recall budget can expire first.
settings.syncHint: Control when background sync runs, tasks per batch and the maximum wait for each build stage. Editing these settings does not remove saved memories or indexes.
settings.storageHint: Control compaction and write protection. Compaction only removes redundant vector-store versions; old build generations are cleaned manually under Build generations and datasets.
settings.recallBudgetLink: Configure the overall AI deep-recall budget
settings.storageLink: View storage location in unified data management

cognee.maintenanceOpenHint: Open version cleanup, storage compaction and rebuild actions; each requires confirmation
cognee.maintenanceHint: Choose an action and confirm. Maintenance runs after the current batch; you can close this window after submitting. Conversations and native memory writes can continue. A version backlog continues within the configured count and time budgets, validating and publishing a recovery point after each round. Continuation rounds only prune versions; they do not repeat fragment merges.
cognee.maintenanceProgress: {{rounds}} rounds completed · {{versions}} old versions cleaned · {{size}} reclaimed
cognee.maintenanceRunning: {{action}}: running, including validation and recovery snapshot publication
cognee.maintenanceStale: Status could not be refreshed. Close this window and refresh before requesting maintenance.
cognee.cleanupHint: Remove expired vector history only, without merging fragments or rebuilding the graph. Keep current memories and a valid recovery point.
cognee.cleanupConfirm: Clean versions older than the configured retention period within the per-round count and continuation time budgets, without merging fragments. Current memories and native data are retained; removed history can no longer be queried. Each round is validated and publishes a new recovery snapshot. This may take several minutes. Continue?
cognee.compactHint: Merge vector fragments and clean expired versions while retaining current memories. Uses more time, disk I/O and temporary space than version cleanup alone.
cognee.compactConfirm: Run one round of fragment compaction and expired version cleanup, retaining current memories. This may take several minutes and temporarily use more disk space; the next graph sync batch waits. A new recovery snapshot is published after validation. Continue?
cognee.backfillHint: Queue existing active memories and relations for synchronization again. May increase extraction calls and backlog; does not create a new index generation.
cognee.rebuildHint: Start or resume a full build, retaining native memories and older generations. Requires model usage and extra disk space; switch only after validation.
cognee.freshRebuildHint: Restart extraction in a new generation instead of continuing the current build. Retains native memories and older generations; requires more time and disk space.

docs.title: Document Index
docs.empty: No documents yet. PDF / Word / TXT / MD are supported; uploaded files are parsed, indexed and included in memory recall.
docs.deleteConfirm: Delete document "{{name}}"? Its index and file on disk will also be removed.

rebuildVectorsConfirm: This wipes ALL memory vectors and rebuilds with the current model (runs in background; semantic search degrades to keyword-only until done). Usually only needed after switching the embedding model. Continue?
fullRebuildConfirm: This wipes the file index and rebuilds from scratch (duration depends on file count; file search may be incomplete meanwhile). Continue?

rulesPanel.title: Memory System Rules
rulesPanel.hint: System-level prompt document (config/memory_rules.md) injected into the stable tools block; the AI has no write path — editable only here as a whole document

recall.placeholder: Enter query text to test what the real recall pipeline returns (same as automatic recall in AI chats, side-effect free)
recall.attributionHint: Identity tags describe involved people; source conversations are not delivery targets.
recall.graphInference: Graph synthesis, not a verbatim quotation.
recall.unknownOrigin: Original source was not recorded; do not infer the speaker.
recall.materialMessages: Source message IDs: {{ids}} (summary material, not sentence citations)
recall.moreOrigins: {{count}} sources in total. Use get_memory for complete provenance.
recall.empty: No results (empty store or no match)
